scope: Document organization and conditional deadline references only; no tax liability, filing decision or submission.
name: Germany

deadlines.label: General 2025 income-tax return deadline
deadlines.appliesWhen: General unextended deadline; advised, agricultural, voluntary or specially extended cases need separate verification.

documents.income: Collect annual Steuerbescheinigungen and bank/broker statements for KAP review.
documents.disposals: Collect disposal, acquisition, loss and corporate-action evidence.
documents.foreign-accounts: Collect foreign income and withholding statements; ask about applicable reporting.
documents.wrappers: Collect contract and contribution records for each account/retirement wrapper.
documents.retirement: Collect pension and retirement-contribution certificates for preparer review.

questions: Confirm resident, nonresident or part-year status.
Ask which capital-income information requires correction or supplementary documents.
Advised-return deadlines and cross-border pension/treaty treatment require separate review.
